title: A MACS protocol for purification of untouched germinal center B cells from unimmunized or germinal center-induced mice
protocol: Harvest mouse spleens from euthanized mice.
Scissor the spleen into 4–5 small segments in a 60 mm culture dish containing 1 mL of PBS.
Gently disassociate splenic tissues between the frosted ends of two glass slides using minimal pressure to release splenocytes.
Make single-cell suspension by gently pipetting up and down more than ten times with a 1 ml pipette.
Filter cells through a 70 μm cell strainer.
Transfer approximately 2.5 × 10^7 splenocytes to an Eppendorf tube.
Centrifuge the cells at 300 × g for 3 minutes and remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 300 μL of 1× RBC Lysis Buffer and incubate on ice for 60–90 seconds.
Wash splenocytes twice with 1 mL PBS by centrifugation at 300 × g for 3 minutes.
Wash CD43 Dynabeads for 5 minutes.
Transfer 100 μL of beads per sample into an Eppendorf tube.
Add 1 mL of PBS to resuspend the beads.
Place the tube on a magnet for 1 minute.
Place the Eppendorf tube on the magnet with the tube closely contacting the magnet wall.
Keep the tube open when collecting beads-free supernatant.
Position the Eppendorf tube on the rotator at an approximate 30-degree angle to the axis of the rotator for smooth and constant movement of beads in the tube.
Discard the supernatant after placing the tube on the rotator.
Repeat wash steps b–d as required.
Resuspend the pellet in 600 μL of CD43 Beads Buffer.
Add 160 μL of pre-washed CD43 beads to the cell suspension and gently mix.
Place the tube on the rotator and rotate at 4°C for 20 minutes.
Remove the tube after rotation and resuspend bead-bound cells by pipetting 10 times.
Place the tube on the magnet for 2 minutes.
Transfer the supernatant containing the unbound B cells to a new tube.
Pellet cells by centrifugation at 300 × g for 3 minutes.
Resuspend the pelleted cells in 50 μL CD43 Beads Buffer containing 3% FBS.
Add 2 μL biotinylated anti-IgD antibody, mix thoroughly.
Incubate on ice for 20 minutes.
Prepare Biotin Binder beads according to manufacturer's instructions.
Transfer 150 μL of prepared beads into an Eppendorf tube.
Wash the beads twice in 1 mL PBS by placing them on a magnet and removing supernatant each time.
Resuspend the washed beads in 150 μL CD43 Beads Buffer.
Wash cells twice in 600 μL PBS, centrifuging at 300 × g for 3 minutes between washes and resuspending cells each time.
Add 150 μL pre-washed Biotin Binder beads to the cell suspension.
Add 40 μL pre-washed CD43 beads to the cell suspension.
Gently mix the bead-bound cells by pipetting up and down.
Place the tube on a rotator at 4°C for 20 minutes, rotating and tilting the tube as shown in Figure 3B.
Resuspend the bead-bound cells by gently pipetting 10 times.
Place the tube back on the magnet for 2 minutes.
Transfer the supernatant containing unbound GC B cells to a new tube.
Pellet cells at 350 × g for 5 min.
Resuspend pellet in 50 μL CD43 Beads Buffer.
Add 1 μL each of biotinylated IgD, CD11c, and CD38 antibodies.
Mix the solution thoroughly.
Incubate on ice for 15–20 minutes.
Wash cells with 600 μL PBS by centrifugation at 350 × g for 5 min and resuspend in 50 μL Annexin V Beads Buffer.
Add 1 μL biotinylated Annexin V, mix and incubate on ice for 15 min.
Transfer 100 μL beads into an Eppendorf tube.
Add 1 mL of PBS to the beads, resuspend, place the tube on magnet for 1 min, remove supernatant, repeat wash steps.
Resuspend in 100 μL Annexin V Beads Buffer (use CD43 Beads Buffer if skipping Annexin V incubation).
Wash cells twice with 600 μL 1× Annexin V Buffer (use PBS instead if skipping Annexin V incubation) by centrifugation at 350 × g for 5 min.
Resuspend washed cells in 600 μL Annexin V Beads Buffer (use CD43 Beads Buffer if skipping Annexin V incubation).
Add 100 μL pre-washed Biotin Binder beads, gently mix.
Place the tube on a rotator and rotate at 4°C for 20 min.
Resuspend bead-bound cells by pipetting 10 times to prevent trapping of unbound GC B cells.
Place the tube on a magnet for 2 min.
Transfer unbound GC B cells to a new tube.
